question: Operation ‘Smiling Buddha’ is associated with:
solution:
The correct answer is__** ​India's first nuclear test.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Operation ‘Smiling Buddha’ **is associated with** India's first nuclear test.**
 
• **'Smiling Buddha' **was the first **nuclear test conducted by India** in a place named** Pokhran (Rajasthan) in the year 1974.**
 
• **The peaceful test codenamed 'Smiling Buddha' helped India become the sixth country in the world to conduct a nuclear test.**
 
• The test was conducted **on May 18, 1974, under the supervision of Raja Ramanna, who was the Director of Bhabha Atomic Research Center.**
 
• The test was named** 'Smiling Buddha' **because** it was conducted on Buddha Purnima that year.**
 
• With** this feat, India became the first country outside the five permanent UNSC members to conduct the test.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• About High Yielding Variety (HYV):

 
 
• **High Yielding Variety (HYV) seeds are seeds, which produce large quantities of crops especially wheat and rice.**
 
• The use of these** seeds requires a regular supply of water and optimum use of fertilizer and pesticides in correct proportions.**
 
• HYV seed** Leema Rojo was the most successful variety that increased the yield of wheat in the Punjab manifold.**
 
• **Brinjal **is the first** one to get the Genetic Engineering Appraisal Committee (GEAC) approval.**
 
• Bt cotton is **the only other gm crop permitted in the country.**
